name: Treasury pay
description: Pays a recipient from a budget, over its account's rail, and writes the ledger line. Refused if the budget or the account's spend limit would be exceeded. Fails if the rail did not pay: then the budget has the amount back, unless the rail could not say whether it paid, when it stays drawn and the ledger line says so.

recipient.description: Who is paid, in the rail's own form (Convex: #n)

amount.description: How much, in the currency's smallest unit

reason.description: The ledger line: what is paid for and on what authority

output.description: The ledger line: n, budget, account, recipient, currency, amount, reason, by, at, status (paid) and what the rail reported.
